content.question: Does weight decay 1 versus 0 improve held-out generalization after memorization, and does delayed grokking occur by 100000 updates in the prescribed modular-addition MLP?
constraints: Ordered modular addition modulo 97; 2822 training and 6587 held-out pairs per seed
All setup and computation via local broker, offline and sequential
Compute 1800 seconds; setup 300 seconds; 64 attempts; per request at most 180 seconds; session 3600 seconds
stop_rules: Failed correctness or infeasible cost qualification stops confirmation
Resource ceiling produces a partial package
Confirmation horizon is fixed at 100000 and never shortened based on results
All attempts persist and retries get new identities
At most two audit revision cycles
